definitions.explanation: The speed at which something happens or someone does something. Often used for work speed, running speed, or the rate of drinking/eating.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ペース⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
examples.english: Do it at your own pace.

examples.japanese: ペース⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{速|はや}すぎて、⟦ついていけない→ついていく：10991_tsuiteiku⟧。
examples.english: The pace is too fast — I can't keep up.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧ペース⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲|の}んだら→飲む：00322_nomu⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{酔|よ}って→酔う：14437_you⟧しまう⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: If you drink at this pace, you'll get drunk in no time.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ペース⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ is one of the most common phrases in Japanese, meaning "at one's own pace." It carries the nuance of not being rushed by others and doing things comfortably.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ペース⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: at one's own pace
- ペース⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧／⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧: the pace is fast/slow
- ペース⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧／⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧: to pick up/slow down the pace
- ペース⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乱|みだ}す→乱す：11412_midasu⟧: to disrupt someone's pace
- ペース⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to maintain one's pace
- マイペース: going at one's own pace (describes a person who doesn't follow others)
- ハイペース: high pace, fast rate
